recipe.visualDefinition: A profile portrait of a man with wavy hair and a mustache, rendered in a mixed-media style that combines soft watercolor washes with sharp graphite pencil hatching on a textured, aged paper background.
coreVisualRelationships: Soft watercolor skin tones contrasted by sharp pencil outlines
Vertical text alignment balancing the horizontal gaze of the subject
Warm sepia background unifying the cool graphite shadows
Rough paper texture visible through both subject and background

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Subject is centered, occupying the middle and lower two-thirds of the frame in a medium close-up.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The subject's eye and the bridge of the nose serve as the primary focal point.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: The viewer's eye follows the subject's gaze from right to left, then moves down the vertical text on the left margin.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Ample negative space around the head, filled with subtle watercolor blooms and paper texture.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Warm beige and cream (background and highlights)
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Charcoal grey and burnt umber (pencil lines and hair shadows)
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Terracotta and peach (skin mid-tones and text highlights)
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Low saturation throughout; high value contrast between the white shirt and dark hair.

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.baseSkeleton: Hand-drawn sans-serif with varying stroke weights
letterConstructionRules: Inconsistent baseline and kerning to mimic handwriting
characterSpecificRedesigns: Letters are stacked vertically but read bottom-to-top
Occasional orange-tinted highlights behind specific characters
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Single hand-drawn style to maintain an intimate, sketchbook feel.

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the organic, sketchbook quality of the illustration.
Provides a similar tactile, printed feel.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a watercolor and graphite portrait of a man in profile on textured cream paper. Use soft washes for skin and sharp pencil hatching for hair and shadows. Leave the left margin clear for text.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add vertical hand-drawn charcoal lettering along the left edge, rotated 90 degrees counter-clockwise. Include subtle orange watercolor streaks behind the text.

verificationChecks: Does the portrait combine pencil lines with watercolor?
Is the background texture visible through the subject?
Is the color palette restricted to earth tones?

adjustableVariables: Width of the vertical text margin
postGenerationChecks: Ensure the pencil lines look like graphite, not digital brushes.
Check that the watercolor 'bleeds' naturally into the paper texture.
Verify the text is legible despite the hand-drawn style.
Confirm the subject's gaze creates a strong directional lead.
recipe.reuseFormula: Mixed-media portrait [Subject Description] + [Watercolor/Graphite Technique] + [Textured Paper Background] + [Vertical Hand-drawn Typography]
